title: Mycology
description: Fungi are threads, not plants: they feel their way through the ground and digest it from outside. Unlocks the Mycelium Bed, Mould Cultures and Antibiotics.

puzzle.goal: A mould colony starts at radius a and its edge advances v millimetres a day. Write its radius R after t days.
puzzle.name: Hyphal front
puzzle.ask: Find R for a = @{a}, v = 3 and t = @{t}.
puzzle.method: Only the tips of the threads grow, so the edge moves at a steady speed: a straight line in time.
